source: The nine spheres of the Ledger (master build section 19.1): each one object with three faces, depth (which rows you enter, by ledger-rows.json id), shadow (what the numbers reveal, measured by shared/spheres.js and never shown by name outside the drawer) and virtue (the word on screen). The mapping is the brief's table; the row ids are this repo's registry.
confidenceNote: An ordering and a set of measurements, not findings. Depth gates precision, never access: every sphere is visible from the start.
note: Read by the Ledger rings, the Dashboard tiles, the tree map's roots and every room's sphere badge; no second copy anywhere. depth.minutes is the sum of the rows' minutes in data/ledger-rows.json. shadow.sentence takes {n}, {minutes} and {dollars} and carries no judgement word. The six situation rows sit in sphere 1 (they are the first six rows of the Ledger, 18.7), not sphere 4 as the brief's row pattern lists; sphere 9 has no rows until the time budget (16.12) adds the hours and the day-off price (D-184).

spheres.virtueLine: One number a letter, and who you are.
spheres.sharpens: the FI date to the decade

shadow.name: Limbo
shadow.sentence: {n} numbers you have never touched. About {minutes} minutes to enter them.

spheres.drawer: Paradiso, sphere of the Moon: the inconstant. Inferno, circle one: limbo. Same measure, read from two sides.

spheres.virtueLine: Needs, wants, each debt, each account, each kind of pay.
spheres.sharpens: the FI date to five years

shadow.name: Gluttony
shadow.measure: the Joy Curve lowest line: what The Rerank would cut, a year
shadow.sentence: {dollars} a year on the line you rated lowest. Pick the one you keep.

spheres.drawer: Paradiso, sphere of Mercury: the ambitious. Inferno, circle three: gluttony. Same measure, read from two sides.

spheres.virtueLine: Who is in it, how you file, what you give.
spheres.sharpens: the FI date to two years

shadow.name: Envy
shadow.sentence: {n} dreams priced but not dated, {dollars} a month between them. Date one, make it a block.

action.label: Date it, make it a block

spheres.drawer: Paradiso, sphere of Venus: the lovers. Inferno, circle two: envy is Purgatorio's; here it is the wanting without a date. Same measure, read from two sides.

spheres.virtueLine: Rough numbers, named and confirmed; the dates money lands.
spheres.sharpens: the FI date to the quarter

shadow.name: Fraud
shadow.measure: count of rows with confidence roughly or unknown
shadow.sentence: {n} numbers you have been guessing. About {minutes} minutes to confirm them.

spheres.drawer: Paradiso, sphere of the Sun: the wise. Inferno, circle eight: fraud. Same measure, read from two sides.

spheres.virtueLine: What holds when a month goes wrong.
spheres.sharpens: the FI date to the month

shadow.name: Wrath
shadow.measure: interest a month on the highest-rate line
shadow.sentence: {dollars} a month of interest on the line at {n}%. One move calms it.

action.label: The one move that calms it

spheres.drawer: Paradiso, sphere of Mars: the warriors. Inferno, circle five: wrath. Same measure, read from two sides.

spheres.virtueLine: How each account is taxed, what it cost, what the match is worth.
spheres.sharpens: net worth after tax to the cent

shadow.name: Greed
shadow.sentence: {dollars} of cash above {n} months of spending, earning nothing. Put the idle part to work.

action.label: Put the idle part to work

spheres.drawer: Paradiso, sphere of Jupiter: the just. Inferno, circle four: greed. Same measure, read from two sides.

spheres.virtueLine: The loans, the cover, the tax lines: the full cost of the life.

shadow.name: Pride
shadow.measure: the car as a share of net worth
shadow.sentence: {dollars} of car, {n}% of what you own. Set the number where you stop.

action.label: Set the number where you stop

spheres.drawer: Paradiso, sphere of Saturn: the contemplatives. Purgatorio, terrace one: pride. Same measure, read from two sides.

spheres.virtueLine: What is set aside for later, and who gets it.
spheres.sharpens: the plan against what actually happened

shadow.name: Treachery
shadow.measure: the gap between the estimated month and the actual one
shadow.sentence: {dollars} between what you planned for last month and what happened. Re-date one.

spheres.drawer: Paradiso, sphere of the fixed stars: the triumphant. Inferno, circle nine: treachery. Same measure, read from two sides.

spheres.virtueLine: The hours, and what a day off costs.
spheres.sharpens: nothing further: the numbers are done

shadow.name: Sloth
shadow.measure: days off taken against what the real hourly wage affords
shadow.sentence: {n} days off this year that you could afford and did not take. Take one, priced.

spheres.drawer: Paradiso, the Primum Mobile: the angels. Purgatorio, terrace four: sloth. Same measure, read from two sides.
